The former US ambassador to Turkey also says Ankara should be allowed to rejoin the F-35 program, but only after it gives up possession of Russia's S-400 missile system. Kennedy also says that, "if I had to bet," the Senate Judiciary Committee will not vote on Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general tomorrow. This is the fifth straight meeting where fed officials have elected to leave rates unchanged. Talking to reporters, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated his goal to bring down inflation and but stopped short of saying he would raise rates.  Warsh said raising rates 'could well be part of that solution,' but not in isolation. Bloomberg's Tom Keene, Jon Ferro and Lisa Abramowicz discuss remarks from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh following the Federal Reserve's latest policy decision on a special edition of Bloomberg Surveillance. title: Trump Unveils $20 Billion Plan for Washington Dulles Revamp
title_cn: 特朗普公布 200 亿美元的华盛顿杜勒斯机场改造计划
summary: President Donald Trump announced a plan to overhaul and expand Washington Dulles International Airport near the nation’s capital, his latest makeover project for the region, calling it a “long-overdue renovation and reconstruction.”

title: Trump Seeks Supreme Court Review to Revive Dismissed Clinton Lawsuit
title_cn: 特朗普寻求最高法院复审以恢复被驳回的克林顿诉讼
summary: President Donald Trump said he will ask the US Supreme Court to revive his failed lawsuit accusing Hillary Clinton, the Democratic National Committee and others of conspiring to tarnish his 2016 campaign with bogus claims of collusion with Russia.

title: Trump’s Economic Record Fuels Midterms Messaging
title_cn: 特朗普的经济记录助推了中期选举的消息传递
summary: The president’s unpopularity will weigh on campaign strategies this fall.

title: Israel Aims to Make Pilotless Warplane With F-35 Capabilities
title_cn: 以色列计划制造具有F-35能力的无人驾驶战机
summary: Israel plans to make a pilotless warplane with capabilities akin to the US-supplied F-35 stealth fighter, a senior official said, as the country turns toward independent military production amid growing isolation over its wars.

title: Trump Says US Will Strike Iran Hard as War Escalates Again
title_cn: 特朗普表示，随着战争再次升级，美国将严厉打击伊朗
summary: President Donald Trump said the US would strike back at Iran after a recent attack that targeted a military base in Jordan, as the war in the Middle East flared up again following a pause in hostilities.

title: Warsh Says There Was Much Agreement on Hard Questions
title_cn: 沃什表示，在难题上达成了很多共识
summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh says there was much agreement among policymakers when it came to hard questions.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed's Warsh Says There Is No Soft Inflation Target
title_cn: 美联储沃什表示没有软通胀目标
summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh says the fight to bring down inflation has just begun. “Let me reiterate: there is no soft inflation target, there is no soft implicit target, not on this committee’s watch," he said during a press conference in Washington. Warsh says "there's only a target, and it's 2%." (Source: Bloomberg)
